$comment: Documentation-coverage floor for #1241, read by scripts/docs-ratchet.mjs in the required `validate` job of harness-quality.yml. It is the BACKSTOP to the #865 merge-base identity rule, which fails a PR whose diff unlinks a documented file but cannot see dilution: PRs that each add only undocumented files are green under it forever while coverage walks down. Raise the floor when coverage rises; never lower it to make CI pass.
$whatCounts: harness check-docs (CLI 12.10.1, core checkDocCoverage) counts a source file (**/*.{ts,js,tsx,jsx,mjs,cjs} under rootDir, minus entropy.excludePatterns) as documented when a markdown link `[text](target)` in a .md file UNDER docsDir (./docs) has a target equal to the file's repo-relative path (one leading ./ or ../ stripped) or to its basename. Links in AGENTS.md, README.md, CHANGELOG.md or any other markdown outside docs/ are never read, and a backtick path is not a link. That is why scripts/schedule-staleness.mjs (PR #1235) reads as undocumented although AGENTS.md links it. The basename match also means one link to a common name (e.g. index.ts) documents every file of that name.
$metric: Coverage is measuredDocumented / measuredScanned * 100, computed from the report's file lists. harness prints Math.round of that ratio, so its '18.0%' is 17.95% here and would hide up to half a point of drift.
$headroom: minCoveragePercent sits maxHeadroom points below the measurement, the same deliberate slack the entropy and perf ceilings carry. A floor pinned exactly to the measurement fails the next PR that adds one undocumented file, which is the #864 failure #865 removed the old --min-coverage 3 floor for. One point is about 22 undocumented files at 390 scanned before the floor fires, with no doc added in between.
$restamp: The floor never moves on its own. When coverage rises more than maxHeadroom above the floor, the ratchet prints the values to write; commit them in a PR (chore(ratchet): restamp ...), measured in a clean worktree with the CLI the workflow resolves. Lowering minCoveragePercent is refused by ts/test/docs-ratchet.test.ts, which compares it against git HEAD.
$instrument: harnessCli is the EXACT version that measured this file. The workflow pins a floating @12, so the ratchet abstains (exit 3) when CI resolves a different version. Re-measure and update harnessCli in the same PR; do not delete it to silence the abstention.
